author: the internet slop warehouse
title: Stillwater Field Station
description: A small immersive woodland playground: walk textured trails, explore scanned Poly Haven props, toggle a detailed generator and shelter lights, turn a working radio dial, and toss ballistic stones at three ringing bells. Optional cache finds; no required quest, timer or ending. Instanced forest/ferns, terrain collisions, HDR image-based lighting, PBR ground and optional spatial sound. WASD/right-drag/E/Space or touch. New assets and systems were published first for reuse in future 3D worlds.
